name: ui-algorithm-canvas
description: AlgorithmCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui algorithm-canvas pattern).

schema.name: ui-algorithm-canvas
schema.description: AlgorithmCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui algorithm-canvas pattern).

events.name: Update
events.description: Live scene update; payload carries the current drawable state.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: Grid/array/DP cells; laid out on a row/col lattice sized to the extent.

slotOrientation.label: Slot Orientation
slotOrientation.description: Slot stack direction; horizontal lays slots left-to-right, vertical stacks bottom-up.

slots.label: Slots
slots.description: Discrete value slots (registers/variables); laid out in a row or a vertical stack.

auxBars.label: Aux Bars
auxBars.description: Secondary bar strip inside the bars panel (e.g. a running total beside the primary values).

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: Extra declarative shapes in canvas pixel coordinates.

pointers.label: Pointers
pointers.description: Index cursors (i/j/lo/hi/mid); drawn as markers beneath the referenced bar/slot column.

colLabels.label: Col Labels
colLabels.description: Column-header labels drawn above the cells grid.

bars.label: Bars
bars.description: Sorting/histogram bars; laid out left-to-right, height proportional to value.

ranges.label: Ranges
ranges.description: Highlighted index ranges over the bars panel (translucent fill bands or labeled brackets).

frames.label: Frames
frames.description: Recursion/call-stack frames; laid out bottom-up like a real call stack.

rowLabels.label: Row Labels
rowLabels.description: Row-header labels drawn to the left of the cells grid.

buckets.label: Buckets
buckets.description: Hash-table buckets; each row is an index chip plus its chained entries.
